<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param '
    <!ENTITY ent "parsed entity value">
    <!ENTITY % subparam "<!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>">
    %subparam;
  '>
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binary-data SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/main" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comments -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and -- comments-- inside.
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % internal_macro "<!ENTITY e3 'Nested Parameter &e1;'>">
  %internal_macro;
  <?xml-target data="processing instruction payload"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://schema.example.com/doc" xmlns:meta="http://schema.example.com/meta">
  <!-- Comment 1 before section -->
  <section meta:id="s1">
    <?meta-pi command="parse"?>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with complex text.
    ]]>
    &e2;
  </section>
  <section meta:id="s2">
    <!-- Comment 2 inside second section -->
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block &e3;
    ]]>
  </section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base "Catalog Root">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Extension">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-ext "<!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-ext;
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active" version="1.0"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://ns.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Document catalog comment block -->
  <item id="i1">
    <?xi:include href="fragment.xml"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed data with <markup> and & entities.
    ]]>
    &extended;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY prod-name "Widget">
  <!ENTITY prod-desc "High performance &prod-name;">
  <!ENTITY % attr-def "<!ATTLIST product code CDATA #IMPLIED>">
  %attr-def;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.example.com/ns" xmlns:v="http://inventory.example.com/version">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <product code="P001" v:version="2.0">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block for product description with special characters < > & " '
    ]]>
    &prod-desc;
  </product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY r1 "Record One">
  <!ENTITY r2 "Record Two with &r1;">
  <!ENTITY % level1 "<!ENTITY % level2 '<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>'> %level2; ">
  %level1;
  <?xml-meta name="author" content="Tester"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns/base" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <html:div>
    <?html-action refresh="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Embedding HTML-like structure inside CDATA block.
    ]]>
    <record xlink:type="simple">&r2;</record>
  </html:div>
</archive>
```
